ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state-style skeleton structure, with curved reaction arrows; according to the problem statement these arrows need to be ignored. The retained atom connectivity is that the left R¹ is connected to the central carbon, the central carbon is also connected to R² and forms a double bond with nitrogen; the nitrogen is then singly bonded to oxygen, and the oxygen is connected to the PCl₄ group. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the structure can be written as R1-C(R2)=N-O-PCl4. Represent the two unspecified substituents R¹ and R² with the SMILES wildcard *; write the central carbon as connected to one wildcard and bearing another wildcard branch, namely *C(*). Retain the C=N double bond, followed by NOP, and write the four chlorines on phosphorus as P(Cl)(Cl)(Cl)Cl. Therefore the SMILES is *C(*)=NOP(Cl)(Cl)(Cl)Cl.

method.method_draft: First ignore all curved reaction arrows as instructed. Convert the remaining skeletal structure into atom connectivity: R1-C(R2)=N-O-PCl4. Replace R1 and R2 by wildcard atoms in SMILES, write the carbon as bonded to one wildcard before it and one wildcard branch, preserve the C=N double bond, then append NOP with four chlorine substituents on phosphorus. This yields *C(*)=NOP(Cl)(Cl)(Cl)Cl.

图像描述：图中显示一个过渡态样式的骨架结构，并带有弯曲反应箭头；按题意这些箭头需要忽略。保留的原子连接为左侧 R¹ 连接到中心碳，中心碳还连接 R²，并与氮形成双键；氮再单键连接氧，氧连接到 PCl₄ 基团。
推理：忽略箭头后，结构可写成 R1-C(R2)=N-O-PCl4。将 R¹ 和 R² 两个未指定取代基用 SMILES 通配符 * 表示；中心碳写作与一个通配符相连并带另一个通配符支链，即 *C(*)。保留 C=N 双键，后接 NOP，并把磷上的四个氯写为 P(Cl)(Cl)(Cl)Cl。因此 SMILES 为 *C(*)=NOP(Cl)(Cl)(Cl)Cl。
